name: SMBX: Level Contest Japan
summary: A compilation episode for a contest where each participant could submit up to three levels made in any of the available SMBX versions or monstrosities that looked like versions (1.3, 2.0, 38A). It was advertised on both the SMBX forums and Talkhaus, so in the end quite a large variety of participants submitted, and the international nature of the contest is clear, with submissions from everywhere from the US to Japan to Indonesia.
